# gitea_repository_webhook (Data Source)

Fetches details of a specific repository webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_webhook" "example" {
  username = "my-org"
  name     = "my-repo"
  id       = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Webhook ID
- `name` (String) Repository name
- `username` (String) Owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active
- `authorization_header` (String, Sensitive) Webhook authorization header
- `branch_filter` (String) Branch filter on the webhook
- `channel` (String) Channel name for Slack webhooks
- `color` (String) Hex color code for Slack webhooks
- `config` (Map of String) Key-value configuration map for the webhook
- `content_type` (String) Payload content type (`json` or `form`)
- `created_at` (String) Webhook creation timestamp
- `events` (List of String) List of events that trigger the webhook
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method used for the webhook
- `icon_url` (String) Icon URL for Slack or Discord webhooks
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook secret
- `slack_username` (String) Bot username for Slack webhooks
- `type` (String) Webhook type, e.g. `gitea`, `slack`, etc.
- `url` (String) Target URL of the webhook
